PM Modi Visit Bihar : loktantr ki dharti vaishali se pradhanmantri narendr modi aaj 34 hajar karor rupye ki vikas yojnaon ka shilanyas aur udghatan karenge. pradhanmantri ke aagman ko lekar rajapakar prakhand ke japharpatti sthit karyakram sthal par neta-karyakarta ke sath aam log pahunch chuke hain. karyakram sthal par khaskar mahilaon men pradhanmantri ko dekhne aur sunne ko lekar jabardast utsah dekhne ko mil raha hai.
